title: 产品安全与质量
summary: 评估公司产品质量与安全管理，包括召回事件、质量投诉及质量管理体系。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Product Safety & Quality Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Product Safety & Quality is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their exposure to possible recalls or product safety concerns, the strength of their supply chain and sourcing systems, their quality management efforts in manufacturing and their responsible marketing practices.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍产品安全与质量关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。产品安全与质量属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖潜在召回或产品安全问题的风险敞口、供应链与采购体系的健全程度、制造过程中的质量管理措施，以及负责任营销实践。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: \- Damage to brand value from loss of consumer trust or negative publicity.
blocks.content_cn: • 因消费者信任丧失或负面报道而损害品牌价值。

blocks.content: \- Increased costs to comply with additional regulatory requirements or litigation.
blocks.content_cn: • 因遵守额外监管要求或应对诉讼而增加成本。

blocks.content: \- Increased costs of implementing large-scale product recalls or to fulfill warranties.
blocks.content_cn: • 因实施大规模产品召回或履行保修义务而增加成本。

sections.title_en: Product Safety & Quality Key Issue Score
sections.title_cn: 产品安全与质量关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Product Safety & Quality Key Issue Score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue Score is based on the Exposure Score and the Management Score using the formula below. The Exposure Score and the Management Score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue Score.
blocks.content_cn: 产品安全与质量关键议题得分评估公司对该议题风险的敞口程度及管理情况。该关键议题得分根据下述公式，基于风险敞口得分和管理得分计算。两项得分的结合方式意味着：风险敞口越高，公司就需要展现越强的管理能力，才能取得相同的总体关键议题得分。

blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

sections.title_en: Product Safety & Quality Management Score
sections.title_cn: 产品安全与质量管理得分

blocks.content: The Product Safety & Quality Management score is based on the weighted average of the relevant indicator scores, modified by controversies. Default indicator weights may be adjusted for the relevance of business activities; an indicator has zero weight when the company has no exposure to the activity it covers.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分按适用指标得分加权平均，再按争议事件调整。指标采用默认权重，并可根据公司业务活动的相关性调整；公司对某指标覆盖的业务活动没有敞口时，该指标权重为零。

blocks.content: $$MGMT_i = \sum_j Indicator\_Score_{j,i} \times Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$$

MGMT_i denotes the Management score excluding controversies; j denotes an applicable indicator and i denotes the company. Component scores aggregate indicator scores using weights scaled within the component.
blocks.content_cn: MGMT_i为争议调整前的管理得分；j表示适用指标，i表示公司。组件得分按组件内重新归一化后的指标权重汇总，不应默认将各组件等权平均。

sections.title_en: Management Score category: Manufacturing and Handling Score
sections.title_cn: 管理得分类别：制造与处理得分

blocks.content: \- Existence of contingency plans/mitigation control systems to ensure that products are in stock, reliable and safe.
blocks.content_cn: • 建立应急计划或风险缓解控制体系，确保产品供应充足、可靠且安全。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has contingency plans/mitigation control systems to ensure that products are in stock, reliable and safe.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否建立应急计划或风险缓解控制体系，确保产品供应充足、可靠且安全。

blocks.content: \- Measures and reports quantitative indicators related to service quality performance or customer protection.
blocks.content_cn: • 衡量并报告服务质量表现或客户保护相关量化指标。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company measures and reports quantitative indicators related to service quality performance or customer protection (e.g., clinical quality reports, customer surveys).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否衡量并报告服务质量表现或客户保护相关量化指标，例如临床质量报告及客户调查。

sections.title_en: - Extent of certification to a widely accepted product safety/quality standard.
sections.title_cn: • 获得广泛认可的产品安全或质量标准认证的程度。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company certifies its own operations with a widely accepted product safety/quality standard (e.g., HACCP, ISO 9001, ISO/TS 16949, ISO 13485 or equivalent).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否使自身运营取得广泛认可的产品安全或质量标准认证，例如危害分析与关键控制点（HACCP）、ISO 9001、ISO/TS 16949、ISO 13485 或等效标准。

sections.title_en: - Extent of certification to an internally developed product safety/quality standard.
sections.title_cn: • 获得内部开发产品安全或质量标准认证的程度。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company certifies its own operations with an internally developed product safety/quality standard.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否使自身运营取得内部开发的产品安全或质量标准认证。

sections.title_en: - Scope of employee training on product quality.
sections.title_cn: • 员工产品质量培训的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of the company's employee training on product safety and quality. Best practice is for all employees to receive training on product quality standards.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司员工产品安全与质量培训的覆盖范围。最佳实践是所有员工均接受产品质量标准培训。

sections.title_en: • Extent of product testing capacity.
sections.title_cn: • 产品测试能力的程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company's product testing capacity, e.g., third-party or in-house testing.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司的产品测试能力，例如第三方或内部测试。

sections.title_en: • Audit/control procedures on responsible marketing.
sections.title_cn: • 负责任营销的审计或控制程序。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company audits its own operations to assess compliance with its responsible marketing policies and ethical product promotion.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否审计自身运营，以评估其对负责任营销政策及合乎道德的产品推广要求的遵守情况。

blocks.content: • Policy on responsible marketing, advertising and sales.
blocks.content_cn: • 负责任营销、广告与销售政策。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has explicitly stated a policy on responsible marketing and advertising, and the ethical promotion of its products.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否明确制定负责任营销、广告及合乎道德的产品推广政策。

sections.title_en: - Membership in recognized industry-wide partnership(s) on supply chain risk evaluation and mitigation.
sections.title_cn: • 参与获得认可的全行业供应链风险评估与缓解合作机制。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company is a member of industry initiatives or partnerships that evaluate supply chain risk and undertake relevant mitigation programs.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否加入评估供应链风险并开展相关缓解计划的行业倡议或合作机制。

sections.title_en: - General statement on supplier certification of quality procedures.
sections.title_cn: • 关于供应商质量程序认证的一般性声明。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company makes general statements regarding the certification or oversight of its supply chain quality, without providing further detail on certification at specific levels of its supply chain
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否仅对供应链质量认证或监督作一般性声明，而未提供供应链具体层级认证的进一步详情。

sections.title_en: - Tier 1 - Direct supplier facilities and processes certified by company employees or third-party auditors.
sections.title_cn: • 一级：直接供应商设施及流程由公司员工或第三方审计人员认证。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company oversees the quality processes of its direct supplier (Tier 1) facilities and processes through certification or audits by a third party or by company employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否通过第三方或公司员工认证、审计，监督一级直接供应商设施与流程的质量程序。

sections.title_en: - Tier 2 - Indirect/sub supplier facilities and processes certified by company employees or third-party auditors.
sections.title_cn: • 二级：间接或次级供应商设施及流程由公司员工或第三方审计人员认证。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company oversees the quality processes of its indirect/sub-supplier (Tier 2) facilities and processes through certification or audits by a third party or by company employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否通过第三方或公司员工认证、审计，监督二级间接或次级供应商设施与流程的质量程序。

sections.title_en: - Tier 3 - Ingredients/raw materials checked for quality on a regular basis.
sections.title_cn: • 三级：定期检查成分或原材料质量。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company oversees the quality processes of its ingredients/raw materials (Tier 3) through certification or audits by a third party or by company employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否通过第三方或公司员工认证、审计，监督三级成分或原材料的质量程序。

sections.title_en: - Scope of supplier training on quality standards.
sections.title_cn: • 供应商质量标准培训的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: The extent to which the company trains suppliers on quality standards, requirements and processes. Best practice is to train all suppliers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司对供应商开展质量标准、要求及流程培训的程度。最佳实践是培训所有供应商。

sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure Score
sections.title_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure Score of a business segment is based on a mapping of business segments as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI ESG Research uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure Score. Each business activity score is calculated as the maximum of the Warranty and Recalls Score, Marketing and Services Score, Retail Score, Content Integrity Score and Safety Score of a business activity:
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI ESG 研究使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。各业务活动得分取该活动的保修与召回得分、营销与服务得分、零售得分、内容真实性得分和安全得分中的最大值：

blocks.content:
$$
B S E _ {P S Q, j} = \max \left(W \& R _ {j}, M \& S _ {j}, C I S _ {j}, S S _ {j}\right)
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $W \& R_{j}$ is the Warranty and Recalls Score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $W \& R_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的保修与召回得分。

blocks.content: \- $M \& S_{j}$ is the Marketing and Services Score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $M \& S_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的营销与服务得分。

blocks.content: • $CIS_{j}$ is the Content Integrity Score for business activity j.
blocks.content_cn: • $CIS_{j}$ 为业务活动 j 的内容真实性得分。

blocks.content: \- $SS_{j}$ is the Safety Score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $SS_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的安全得分。

blocks.content: The Warranty and Recalls Score is calculated as the average of the Warranty Score, Safety Regulator Score and Recalls Score. The Warranty Score is calculated from the average warranty reserve ratio (warranty reserves/total assets). The Safety Regulator Score is developed from a qualitative assessment of whether a business activity is regulated in the United States by the FDA, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) or Federal Aviation Administration. The Recalls Score is calculated from the number of recalls for each business activity.
blocks.content_cn: 保修与召回得分为保修得分、安全监管得分和召回得分的平均值。保修得分根据平均保修准备金比率，即保修准备金除以总资产计算。安全监管得分通过定性评估业务活动在美国是否受食品药品监督管理局、国家公路交通安全管理局或联邦航空管理局监管确定。召回得分根据各业务活动的召回次数计算。

blocks.content: The Marketing and Services Score is a qualitative assessment depending on (1) whether the business activity is regulated in the United States by the Federal Trade Commission's (FTC's) bureau for marketing and advertising regulations and (2) whether the business activity provides services or products that have addictive properties.
blocks.content_cn: 营销与服务得分采用定性评估，取决于：（1）业务活动在美国是否受联邦贸易委员会有关营销及广告法规的部门监管；（2）业务活动是否提供具有成瘾性的服务或产品。

blocks.content: The Content Integrity Score is a qualitative assessment of the integrity of the information provided by business activities and is specific to media outlets.
blocks.content_cn: 内容真实性得分针对业务活动所提供信息的真实性进行定性评估，专门适用于媒体机构。

blocks.content: The Safety Score is calculated from annual death rates attributable to select business activities that carry health risks (e.g., through injury, contamination or intoxication).
blocks.content_cn: 安全得分根据可归因于特定具有健康风险业务活动的年度死亡率计算，例如通过伤害、污染或中毒产生风险的活动。

sections.title_en: Data Sources
sections.title_cn: 数据来源

blocks.content: The following sources are used to determine the Product Safety & Quality Exposure Score:
blocks.content_cn: 确定产品安全与质量风险敞口得分时使用以下来源：

blocks.content: Jayant R. Kale, et al., 2013, “Contracting with Nonfinancial Stakeholders and Corporate Capital Structure: The Case of Product Warranties,” Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis 48, no. 3: 699-727; Consumer Product Safety Commission; FDA; Department of Agriculture; NHTSA; FTC; Refinitiv; MSCI ESG Research; company disclosures.
blocks.content_cn: Jayant R. Kale 等，2013 年，《与非金融利益相关方订约及企业资本结构：产品保修案例》，《金融与定量分析杂志》第 48 卷第 3 期：699—727 页；美国消费品安全委员会；美国食品药品监督管理局；美国农业部；美国国家公路交通安全管理局；美国联邦贸易委员会；路孚特；MSCI ESG 研究；公司披露。

sections.title_en: Model Update History
sections.title_cn: 模型更新历史

blocks.content: In June 2022, the Product Safety & Quality Risk Exposure assessment was updated with the removal of a company-specific assessment based on the size of operations.
blocks.content_cn: 2022 年 6 月，产品安全与质量风险敞口评估进行了更新，移除了基于运营规模的公司特定评估。
